item.title: Tank Game
item.description:
Overview

This was a small C++ project using the Raylib graphics library, mostly made to practice my C++ and see what it’s like making a game without an engine. I focused on implementing ‘Design Patterns’, mostly based on the diagrams from Refactoring Guru

It features menu screens, collision detection, powerups, a scoring system, and more. The graphics and gameplay are quite simple, as it’s intended as more of a technical project.
